job_title: Senior SAP MDG Consultant (Business Partner & Finance)
summary: Configure and support SAP MDG Business Partner and Finance implementations and application management: model data/processes/UI, configure change requests and BRFplus/SMT workflows, diagnose incidents and monitor data replication.
requirements: At least seven years of SAP MDG experience, including two or more full lifecycle implementations and substantial AMS/production support; MDG-BP/MDG-FI configuration, workflows/BRFplus/validations/derivations/SMT; replication and IDoc/SOA troubleshooting; SAP SD/FI functional knowledge, documentation and distributed-team delivery. Professional written/spoken English and English resume/interviews. Familiarity with Waterfall and Agile delivery.
conditions: The employer explicitly permits remote work from anywhere in Brazil for a U.S.-based client. Full-time, staff augmentation, duration six months or longer; exact hours are not disclosed. Original publication confirmed by the employer public Posted On field: 2026-11-11. The job is listed on the active employer career board and offers an Apply Now action.
